readme.text: Learn how to set it up by reading the documentation.

streamerbot.title: Streamer.bot
streamerbot.schema_hint: Enable if Streamer.bot is on a remote server (VPS) with HTTPS/TLS. Leave it off if you don't know what you're doing 😊

general.title: Global Settings
general.demo_mode_hint: Starts CreditsRD in test mode, throwing random events
general.tie_hint:
Upon starting the stream on the selected platform,
CreditsRD will clean the previous data from the database
and start anew.
general.tie_info: To restart the credits from the beginning every time the scene appears, enable refresh browser when scene becomes active on your streaming app, and keep shutdown source when not visible disabled so events keep being collected.
general.limit_hint:
Caps the number of events displayed.
(Zero for unlimited).
general.ignore_chatters_hint: Separate the usernames by commas. eg.: Streamlabs,Streamelements

kick.title: Kick
kick.api_warning: During peak usage, Kick's API becomes unstable and takes longer to relay events. This is not an issue with Streamer.bot or CreditsRD. Kick has "infinite money glitch", so I hope it gets better in the future. 😣
